title: Access & Identity V2 — promotion / certification reconciliation, second issuance
why_this_file_exists: The first issuance concluded 'nothing is deployed' and 'promotion is blocked'. Both are now false. Between that report and this one the branch was merged to origin/staging as PR #396. The tranche's CODE shipped; its MIGRATIONS did not, and no pipeline stage ever applies them. That ordering is inverted relative to what the plan requires, and it has taken two operator-facing capabilities offline. This file records what re-derived, by what instrument.

correction_2_the_ordering_is_inverted.failure_mode: FAILS CLOSED, and this matters. PostgREST answers an undefined function with an error, membershipWithProfile.ts:52 classify()s it to kind:'error', and the route returns 400 without writing. No partial membership, no profile-less user_roles row, no privilege granted. This is an AVAILABILITY regression, not a privilege-escalation or data-integrity one. G4's invariant is not breached by the outage — it is breached only if someone 'fixes' this by restoring a direct user_roles insert.
why_the_pipeline_does_not_heal_it: No GitHub workflow runs 'supabase db push', 'supabase migration up', or any equivalent — grep over .github/workflows returns nothing.
vercel.json sets git.deploymentEnabled.staging = true, so the merge deployed the code automatically.
web/package.json prebuild runs verify:module-imports and check:service-client-principal only — no migration step.
Therefore code deploys on merge and migrations never do. The gap does not close on its own and will not close on the next deploy.

correction_6_rl11_is_not_a_defect.first_issuance_said: 'RL-11 subject incomplete — a helper-mediated user_roles writer, lib/dev/createOrgAndAssignAdmin.ts behind POST /api/admin/dev/create-org, remains open.'
correction_6_rl11_is_not_a_defect.now_verified: Not a self-elevation defect. Downgraded to closed-with-note.
evidence: The helper already routes through createMembershipWithAccessProfile (createOrgAndAssignAdmin.ts:76) — it is on the atomic W-5 path, so G4 is not reopened by it.
The route is triple-gated: DEV_TENANT_SPINUP_ENABLED === 'true' (route.ts:22), a valid admin context (:26-27), and ctx.role === 'admin' (:28-30).

The admin membership it writes is for an org inserted in the same call (createOrgAndAssignAdmin.ts:55-70), so no pre-existing principal's authority is widened. Org-creator-becomes-org-admin is provisioning, not elevation.
correction_6_rl11_is_not_a_defect.residual_note: It is a service-role (createAdminClient) path taking a caller-supplied admin_user_id, so an admin may provision a new org administered by a different user. That is within an admin's authority and is cross-org, not self-elevation. Worth a declared route capability under W-14; not a defect today.
